criteria.requirement: Implement versioned pickle state for rrulebase covering rrule and rruleset with cache=True/False. Serialize only definition and cache policy, reconstruct independent locks/iterators, and restart cache computation rather than promising active iterator position. Preserve include/exclude rules/dates, timezone definitions and query results after empty/partial/full cache, deepcopy and legacy uncached dict states. Reject unknown state versions; never load untrusted external pickle. Old original tests/control files remain unchanged.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
